additional_info.subject: L3 escalation
additional_info.body:
the dispenser could not be configured properly. After the dispenser was added in the SCB, the message “partially saved…” appeared. The configuration was not applied. The dispenser configuration was then created manually, but the SCB does not allow this outlet configuration to be saved. The PLC cannot be switched into maintenance mode.
This is outside our scope of resolving.
